auth.loginDescription: Welcome back. Enter your details to continue.
auth.signupDescription: Set up your personal finances to get started.
auth.totpHint: Enter your 6-digit code, or a recovery code if you've lost your authenticator.
auth.error: Sign in failed. Check your credentials.
auth.signupError: Account creation failed. The email may already be in use.
auth.forgotDescription: Enter your email and we'll send you a link to choose a new password.
auth.forgotSent: If that address has an account, a reset link is on its way. Check your inbox and spam folder.
auth.resetDescription: Pick a password you don't use anywhere else.
auth.resetDone: Password updated. You've been signed out everywhere — sign in with your new password.
auth.resetInvalid: This link is invalid or has expired. Request a new one.
auth.resetMissingToken: This link is missing its token. Request a new reset email.
auth.verifyDone: Email confirmed. Thanks — account recovery and alerts are now enabled.
auth.verifyInvalid: This confirmation link is invalid or has expired. Request a new one from Settings.
